title.value: Promoting informed and shared decisions about eHealth solutions for older people and their informal caregivers
title.justification: The title was obtained from the project title mentioned in the paper, which is focused on decision-making regarding eHealth solutions for older populations and their caregivers.
title.quote: Project title : Promoting informed and shared decisions about eHealth solutions for older people and their informal caregivers

extractions.description: The project aims to develop a decision support system using participatory methods for older people with cognitive impairments and their caregivers. It seeks to identify and categorize eHealth solutions by engaging various stakeholders, ensuring the system addresses actual user needs, and considering the challenges of maintaining its relevance with new technologies.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on developing a decision aid tool for eHealth solutions for older people with cognitive impairments. While this is related to healthcare and social welfare, it does not directly address climate or ecological sustainability issues.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: The proposal is well-written and describes the development and testing of a decision support system for older people with cognitive impairment to select eHealth solutions.

primary_category.justification: None of the listed Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development categories directly apply to this paper as it does not address climate or ecological issues. Instead, it focuses on healthcare solutions for elderly care.
primary_category.quote: Scientific quality: This is a well written proposal that aims to develop, using participatory methods, an electronic decision support tool for people with dementia and their carers.

secondary_categories.justification: The paper does not cover secondary Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development areas as it is centered on eHealth solutions for older people.
secondary_categories.quote: The reviewers agree that the project is using cutting edge approaches and addressing a current real-world need given both the expected rise in numbers of older adults living with cognitive impairments and the rapid increase in (unregulated and largely non-evidenced) consumer products targeting this population.

primary_sub_category.justification: None of the sub-categories regarding Climate or Ecological Sustainability are relevant to the focus of this paper, which involves decision-making tools in healthcare.
primary_sub_category.quote: In a nutshell, the project aims at developing a decision support system (DSS) to help elderly with cognitive problems and their informal caregivers find suitable IT-based solutions for getting support in their daily lives.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: No secondary sub-categories of Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development relate to the content of this paper.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: As stated before the team cover the disciplines that I would expect to see within a proposal of this nature. Individually they bring different skills and expertise.

applications.value: Decision support system for eHealth solutions for cognitive impairment
applications.justification: The core application involves the development of a decision support system tailored for older adults with cognitive impairments and their caregivers, to facilitate informed choices in eHealth.
applications.quote: The proposal is well-written and describes the development and testing of a decision support system for older people with cognitive impairment to select eHealth solutions.

new_primary_category.justification: The proposed project aligns more with healthcare and social welfare technology rather than climate or ecological sustainability.
new_primary_category.quote: The project sits within a good number of networks which will ensure that the project has impact.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The focus on developing a decision support tool for eHealth for older individuals with cognitive issues suggests a new sub-category centered on health technology for cognitive care.
